pages.title: Choose what can move
pages.text: In an Automation Field, an Output Item Node takes items out of its attached inventory; an Input Item Node inserts them. Both need filters: an empty filter accepts nothing.$(br2)Double-click player-inventory items to set samples; double-click samples to clear them. The $(thing)ore icon$() matches material tags, such as planks or ingots/silver, allowing equivalent materials from different mods. $(thing)NBT$() (item data) and damage matching are separate options. Check both ends.

pages.title: Send useful batches
pages.text: The Output Node’s stack setting is the $(thing)minimum batch$(), from 1 to 64. A setting of 64 waits for a whole stack. Large batches use less flux per item.$(br2)Add a Round Robin Node behind an Output Node to rotate batches among eligible destinations. Colored conditions can require sensor signals before transferring.$(br2)If transfers stall, check batch availability, destination space, both filters and required conditions.
